truthAudit.Summary: Audit of Run 2 reveals that 7 out of 20 true vulnerabilities were correctly identified, though several suffer from misclassified severity or CWE mappings. 13 vulnerabilities were completely missed. No false positives were found in the original findings. Corrections are required for severity and CWE classifications on four findings.

Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified the format string vulnerability in the debug logger, though it incorrectly rated the severity as Medium instead of Critical.
The integer overflow in the factorial computation loop was not mentioned in Run 2.
The use-after-free risk in memory-pool cleanup during deferred history flush was not identified.

Run 2 correctly identified hardcoded credentials and rated severity correctly as High.
Run 2 correctly identified weak randomness in session tokens, though it misclassified CWE-338 as CWE-330 and severity as Low instead of High.
